description:
Unstick the open dev-loop PRs. The queue retune (builds 5->2, timeout) is MOVED INTO the flip (dlv2-f3): scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py pins APPROVED_MERGE_QUEUE (ALLGREEN, 60 min, build 5, merge 5) in code on develop, and ruleset-drift is required, so changing live queue parameters before develop's pinned values change fails every PR closed (G11). A 15-second attempt at 12:04:56-12:05:11Z on 2026-09-29 was reverted from backup; no drift run overlapped it.
Steps: (1) #2444 (dlv2-32) green, enqueued ALONE, merged; then immediately add `tooling` to ruleset 15611785 required checks (its drift contract documents `tooling`; the gap is fail-closed until added). (2) Then enqueue green #2439 (ledger) and #2441 (chdb guard). (3) #2443 (tiering) is green and was in the queue at 12:04Z. Stale-base PRs (>~1 day behind develop) fail the fast-lane baseline guard because the exact-SHA cache key expired: rebase before enqueueing.
